behavioral_effects: Backend tmp_path fixtures are immune to the machine's per-user temp root state, mirroring the governance suite's arrangement
All pytest scratch for both suites now lives under one gitignored .cache tree
compatibility_impact: pytest --basetemp on the command line still wins (the hook defers to it); cache_dir moves from backend/.pytest_cache to .cache/pytest-backend-cache at the repo root
limitations: The one-time ACL cleanup of the poisoned directories was manual and elevated (owner-performed); this change prevents recurrence from breaking the suite but cannot prevent a foreign-context process from poisoning other paths
reason: The machine's per-user pytest temp root and backend/.pytest_cache were both left ACL-poisoned by a run under a different security context (elevated terminal or agent sandbox), which made every tmp_path fixture error at setup and forced ad-hoc exclusion of the rag-docker-integration file. The governance suite anchored its basetemp to the repo cache from day one for exactly this environment class; the backend suite gets the same arrangement so recurrence is harmless instead of suite-breaking
rollback: git revert restores default temp locations; delete .cache/pytest-backend* to drop the relocated scratch
security_impact: None - test scratch relocation into the gitignored repo cache
summary: Anchor backend pytest scratch to the repo cache

validators_run.evidence_ref: 441 passed, 13 deliberately-gated skips, zero exclusions - the rag-docker-integration file runs in full for the first time this branch, including the tmp_path docling test that erred at setup before; cacheprovider warnings gone
